review: W Ryoshu is a Charge ID who is even more versatile and flexible than W Don. Her S1 is pretty unremarkle, rolling up to 9 and dealing up to 25 damage with 15+ Charge, but her S2 makes up for all of that with it rolling up to 17 when it doesn't have any charge and 23 with 15+ charge. It also inflicts 2 Slash Fragility on top of that and even more bonus damage on it's 3rd coin when the target has low HP. Finally, her S3 is W Don's Rip Space but can be used with at least 7 charge, although she takes a chunk of damage depending on how much charge you're missing from the 15 charge the skill demands, so healing in the form of passives and E.G.O is recommended. If you've spent 15 charge when using the skill, it also refunds back to you and gives another ally 7 Charge if you kill the enemy on it's last coin. Notable E.G.O Synergies: Blind Obsession allows this ID to gain a lot of charge in a sing
